title: Stalks and function field of the spectrum of a domain
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. (1) For every prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ the stalk $\mathcal O_{X,\mathfrak p}$, with the map $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\to\mathcal O_{X,\mathfrak p}$, is a localization of $R$ at $\mathfrak p$; so $\mathcal O_{X,\mathfrak p}\cong R_{\mathfrak p}$ as $R$-algebras. (2) If $R$ is an integral domain with field of fractions $K$, then $X$ is an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], its generic point is the prime $(0)$, and its function field $\mathcal O_{X,(0)}$ is a field of fractions of $R$, i.e. $\mathcal O_{X,(0)}\cong K$ as $R$-algebras.
